models_evaluated: Reinforcement learning model for allocating human feedback

links.outcome: Which smoker subgroups an RL policy prioritizes for scarce human feedback
links.effect: The benefit-maximizing RL model prioritizes people who would benefit most and also those already doing well who want feedback. Alternative ethical principles shift priority to other subgroups, with interdependencies.
links.quote: It not only prioritizes people who would benefit most, but also those who are already doing well and want feedback.
